result.topic_en: For a rod whose end conditions give sin ω = 0, Euler lists the roots ω = nπ, shows the simple tones rise as the squares 1, 4, 9, 16 (giving a musical series), writes the general solution as a superposition of these modes, and notes in Corollary 1 that the fundamental mode has the sine-curve shape of a string and that each higher mode adds one node.
result.transcription:
) 141 (
eſt vt ſit $\sin.\,\omega = 0$. Hinc ergo ſtatim innoteſcunt omnes valores pro angulo $\omega$, quippe qui ſunt:
$\omega = 0,\ \omega = \pi,\ \omega = 2\pi,\ \omega = 3\pi,\ \omega = 4\pi$ etc.
quorum primus locum habet in ſtatu quietis, ſecundus autem ſonum fundamentalem hoc caſu exhibet, ex quo, vt in praecedentibus caſibus, oriuntur ſequentes ſoni:
$\frac{\pi c\sqrt{2gb}}{aa},\ \frac{4\pi c\sqrt{2gb}}{aa},\ \frac{9\pi c\sqrt{2gb}}{aa},\ \frac{16\pi c\sqrt{2gb}}{aa}$ etc.
qui igitur ſoni ſecundum numeros quadratos 1, 4, 9, 16 aſcendunt, ita vt, ſi fundamentalis fuerit C, iſti ſoni conſtituant hanc ſeriem: C, $\overline{c}$, $\overline{\overline{d}}$, $\overline{\overline{\overline{c}}}$, $\overline{\overline{\overline{gis}}}$[?], $\overline{\overline{\overline{\overline{d}}}}$[?], etc. Quod ſi ergo omnes iſtos motus generaliter coniungamus, formula generalis, omnes plane motus, quos virga noſtra recipere poteſt, complectens, erit
$y = C\sin.(\zeta + t\frac{\pi\pi c\sqrt{2gb}}{aa})\sin.\pi u + C'\sin.(\zeta' + t\frac{4\pi\pi c\sqrt{2gb}}{aa})\sin.2\pi u$
$+ C''\sin.(\zeta'' + t\frac{9\pi\pi c\sqrt{2bg}}{aa})\sin.3\pi u + C'''\sin.(\zeta''' + t\frac{16\pi\pi c\sqrt{2gb}}{aa})\sin.4\pi u$
$+$ etc. etc.
vbi ſcripſimus $u$ loco $\frac{s}{a}$.

Corollarium 1.

§. 36. Quando ergo virga ſonum edit fundamentalem, eandem recipiet curuaturam quam chordae ſimpliciter vibrantes, quippe quae erit linea ſinuum, qualem figura prima refert. Pro ſono autem ſimplici ſecundo, quo $\omega = 2\pi$, figura chordae erit (fig. 2), habens vnum nodum in medio O. Pro ſequentibus autem ſonis ſimplicibus numerus nodorum ſemper vnitate augetur.

items.quote: qui igitur ſoni ſecundum numeros quadratos 1, 4, 9, 16 aſcendunt
items.english: These tones therefore ascend according to the square numbers 1, 4, 9, 16.

items.quote: formula generalis, omnes plane motus, quos virga noſtra recipere poteſt, complectens, erit
items.english: The general formula, comprising absolutely all motions which our rod can take, will be [the superposition of the simple modes].

items.quote: Quando ergo virga ſonum edit fundamentalem, eandem recipiet curuaturam quam chordae ſimpliciter vibrantes, quippe quae erit linea ſinuum
items.english: When the rod emits its fundamental tone, it will take the same curvature as simply vibrating strings, namely the curve of sines.

items.quote: Pro ſequentibus autem ſonis ſimplicibus numerus nodorum ſemper vnitate augetur.
items.english: For the following simple tones, the number of nodes always increases by one.
